name: jevmem
description: Automatic project memory for Claude Code. After each message, TypeSafe's Jev decides whether it's worth remembering and saves it as one line in JEVMEM.md in your repo. Opt-in per project. Needs the jevmem CLI from npm and a TypeSafe API key; setup steps are in the README.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Your TypeSafe AI key for Jev (https://console.typesafe.ai/keys). Kept in your system's secure credential store. Leave empty to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment or ~/.jevmem/env.
